# D1 composite Linux machine (#78)
All original generated records. This scenario combines the reviewed Steam native/
Flatpak shared-library, Steam shortcuts, Epic/Heroic/Legendary and Lutris machines.
First-authoritative copies win path conflicts; GOG install metadata explicitly
adds the shared Lutris GOG identity. Desktop proxies deliberately duplicate Steam,
Heroic, Lutris and a non-Steam executable. Hidden apps, utilities, DLC and Steam/
Flatpak runtimes are decoys. A standalone Flatpak game also has its OS export.
No actual user files, game binaries, account data or live scan output is included.
